name: Roar
description: You release an intimidating roar at all opponents within 15 feet of you. Opponents that can hear you must make a {save}. On a fail, the creature is frightened and is forced to immediately move up to its speed in a straight line away from you, or until met with an impeding force (does not provoke attacks of opportunity). A creature frightened in this way must make a {save} at the end of each of its turns to remove the effect.
